title: Context descriptor
description: The frontmatter of domain/<context-slug>/_context.md (SPEC-003) — the one file the underscore keeps outside the element slug space. It declares no relationships: the context map is a projection derived from Contracts. The body carries `## Description` and `## Responsibility`.

strategic.description: Where the business differs, where it is merely specific, and where the problem is already solved.
